# Telemetry contract v1

This directory is the canonical machine-readable pipeline observability contract. `catalog.json` is the generation input; schemas and Go/TypeScript types are generated by `scripts/generate-telemetry-contracts.mjs`.

The wire envelope is flat. Correlation fields and event payload fields remain top-level. Unknown fields are rejected; forward-compatible additions belong in `extensions` until a schema revision admits them.

`seq` is unique and monotonic per `(project, run_id)`, but may contain gaps. `cursor` is the portable semantic cursor `<project>/<run_id>/<seq>`; Redis IDs are transport cursors only. Producers use their source timestamp as `occurred_at` and pipeline admission time as `emitted_at`. Consumers may flag more than 300 seconds of clock skew but must preserve both timestamps.

Minor compatible additions require a regenerated v1 contract. Breaking removal, reinterpretation, or required-field changes require a new contract directory. Payloads that fail identity or schema validation are quarantined and never enter the canonical stream.
